title: Average Order Value By Month
description: For each calendar month, report the **average order value (AOV)** and the number of orders. Name the columns `month`, `orders` and `aov`. Round `aov` to 2 decimal places. Return months in chronological order.
solutionSql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS aov
FROM orders
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
hint: AOV = AVG(total) per month. ROUND to 2 decimals. COUNT(*) counts order rows since each order is one row.
outputExplanation: January averaged $123.45 per order over 4 orders; February averaged $150.00.
